picks.editorial_note: A combined $1.1B+ commitment from Georgia Tech and Emory is one of the largest university AI investments of the year, positioning Georgia as a national AI hub and signaling how deeply institutions are betting on AI for regional economic growth.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Emory Invest More Than $1B in AI to Drive State’s Jobs, Economic Growth

picks.editorial_note: A White House-backed consortium uniting 15 universities across 10 states to pool high-performance computing for AI marks a significant federal push to coordinate academic AI infrastructure at regional scale.
picks.title: UK partners with regional universities in super intelligence computing consortium

picks.editorial_note: SLAC leading a DOE Genesis Mission project to apply autonomous AI discovery to catalysis research could accelerate breakthroughs in clean energy chemistry, backed by major federal investment.
picks.title: SLAC to lead a Department of Energy Genesis Mission project for Super Intelligence (SI)-driven autonomous discovery in catalysis

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's SPIRE project to build fully autonomous 'self-driving laboratories' using AI agents and robots represents a frontier shift in how scientific experiments are run, with DOE backing.
picks.title: SLAC leads new project to build the self-driving laboratory of the future

picks.editorial_note: Phase II Genesis Mission funding for Berkeley Lab's MOAT-Core project shows sustained federal commitment to applying AI to particle accelerator design, a capability with broad scientific payoff.
picks.title: Super Intelligence for Particle Accelerators Gets Another Boost

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's two new Genesis Mission awards extend AI-driven discovery into microelectronics and quantum information science, key strategic technology areas for U.S. competitiveness.
picks.title: Fermilab to lead two new Genesis Mission awards to accelerate development of microelectronics and quantum

picks.editorial_note: An NIH Director's Pioneer Award and nearly $6M to build an AI-human discovery engine for cancer research highlights how large language model agents are being integrated into frontline biomedical science.
picks.title: Dr. Olivier Elemento Wins NIH Director’s Pioneer Award
picks.university: Weill Medical College of Cornell University

picks.editorial_note: A $30M NSF Center spanning Indiana, UT Austin, MIT, Tufts, Utah, and Yale to study human-robot co-adaptation reflects substantial federal investment in a multi-institutional AI robotics research effort.
picks.title: Luddy researchers join new $30 million NSF Center to shape the future of human-robot co-adaptation

picks.editorial_note: TUM spinout RobCo reaching unicorn status with a billion-euro valuation demonstrates how university robotics research is translating directly into high-value commercial AI ventures.
picks.title: RobCo: TUM’s 24th unicorn

picks.editorial_note: The FAA's consideration of AI software to modernize air traffic control signals a potentially consequential shift in how safety-critical national infrastructure incorporates AI decision support.
picks.title: FAA turns to AI to reform air traffic control
